div.div:
This notebook used NLTK to tokenize and index all text files.
1. takes the title, abstract, keyword, from each txt file to create a corpus, and takes the url to create a url corpus
2. saves out the corpus and the url as lists, which are further saved as .pkl files for later import
3. tokenize using "e"n stopwords and creates the BM25 model (indexing)
4. saves out retriever/model as 'lns_bm25'- this is a folder containing many files.
